answer: By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A summit of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree.
